layout.heartBottom: actual vanilla heart bounds including rows and absorption

states.low: fraction <= 0.2; value and amber color remain readable
states.recovering: when fraction>0.2, 2px tip stays inside filled region; low recovery keeps amber fill with no green tip
states.full: existing auto-hide timing remains; full review card demonstrates visible hold period

calculation.outlineDrawOrder: track, clipped fill, optional recovery tip; low takes color priority

behaviorPreserved: existing show/hide conditions and 40 tick full hold

overflow.width: min(112,max(40,guiWidth-24)) preserving current limit; shrink track and clip fill to width-4
overflow.label: use existing k/M abbreviation; align left; shrink gap or split numeric portion only when real font width exceeds available room
overflow.height: label and track move as one block; check fit below heartBottom before applying any bottom clamp; fallback on unusually short viewport requires developer review, do not claim arbitrary rows fit

fontNote: ASCII numerals in preview sample original Minecraft bitmap; Chinese label is layout approximation; actual client uses existing Minecraft font
reviewBoundary: browser composition and native export validated; no Minecraft code modified or game runtime verified
